packages.name: Starter
packages.bestFor: For small businesses that need a consistent, professional social media presence.
deliverables: 6 social media post designs per month
Content calendar, made and filled in for you
Captions and hashtags
Scheduling and posting (we also post your own visuals)
Community management: we answer your DMs and comments
1 boosted post ($10 ad budget included)
2 revision rounds per design
Platforms: Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn
limitations: Extra ad budget above the included boosts is paid by the client
Photography and video shoots are not included
